graders.name: finds-batch-bug
graders.criteria: The review reports as a finding that `delete_objects` skips keys because its loop stops at `len(keys) - 1`: a single key is never deleted, and 1,001 keys leave the last one behind. The approach finding does not crowd this defect out of the report.

graders.name: reuses-helper
graders.criteria: The review reports, in its findings rather than only under next steps or as a passing remark, that `StorageClient.list_objects` reimplements the cursor loop of `iter_pages` in `app/pagination.py`. The finding proposes using `iter_pages` as a snippet or outline, names what that removes or the risk of the two pagination loops drifting apart, and states either the trade-off found or that no material disadvantage was found along with what was checked. Its severity is Medium.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.
